module_summary: UDP transmit framer: an FSM latches parallel UDP/IP header fields, serializes the 8-byte UDP header onto the IP payload stream via hdr_ptr, then forwards length-checked payload through a skid-buffer output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, write UDP header, write payload, payload last, wait last.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input UDP header valid; accepted in IDLE to latch header fields.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready in IDLE when output IP header slot is free.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input UDP payload bytes forwarded after the header.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid gating payload transfer and word count.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input payload ready from FSM, follows output skid buffer readiness.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker; checks length match and returns FSM to idle.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output IP header valid, set when UDP header accepted.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream IP header ready clears header valid.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output IP payload stream: UDP header bytes then payload.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid-buffer output register.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer transfers and early ready.

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: UDP header byte counter selecting which header byte to emit.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload byte count from UDP length; detects mismatch.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output byte mux: header field bytes, payload, or held last byte.

anchors.name: udp_source_port_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched UDP header field serialized onto the stream.

anchors.name: udp_length_reg
anchors.why: Latched UDP length initializing payload word counter.

anchors.name: m_ip_length_reg
anchors.why: IP length computed as UDP length plus 20; representative IP header field.

anchors.name: store_udp_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching all parallel header fields.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final payload byte until frame tlast arrives.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating header emission and skid buffer stores.

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid-buffer temp data register used when output is stalled.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal byte directly into output register.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy when FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse: frame ended before UDP length satisfied.

groups.name: Transmit FSM
groups.description: Sequences header latch, UDP header serialization and payload length tracking.

groups.name: Header registers and serializer
groups.description: Latched header fields; UDP fields muxed byte-wise into the output stream.

groups.name: Payload output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register AXI skid buffer with full-throughput backpressure.
